_comment: Drives the Workshops panel calendar. `sessions` = the standing sessions we offer (booked on request; the booking form captures which one). `upcoming` = specific public group sessions with a fixed date — leave [] when nothing is scheduled and the panel shows a book-on-request message. To add a public session, append: {"session":"walkthrough","date":"2026-08-02","time":"11:00 AM–12:00 PM IST","seatsNote":"25 seats"}. Each session also carries `deck`, the path to its Markdown workshop file under /workshops/. Those files are the same session written so anyone can run it themselves, in Workshopy or on a projector; scripts/check-workshop-decks.py fails CI if a deck path has no file behind it.

sessions.title: JanVayu Walkthrough
sessions.blurb: A live tour of the whole platform. Set AQI alerts for your city, file an RTI in one sitting, read the NCAP scorecard, and size the right purifier for your room.

sessions.title: RTI Clinic
sessions.blurb: Bring your city; leave having filed a real Right to Information request — on clean-air fund utilisation, a missing monitor, or a specific NCAP gap. We draft it with you.

sessions.title: Know Your Ward
sessions.blurb: Read your neighbourhood's air, heat and green-cover maps ward by ward — and understand the honest live-snapshot-vs-annual difference behind the colours.

sessions.title: Air-Literacy for Educators
sessions.blurb: A classroom-ready session for teachers: the learning games, the 10-question self-check, and how to teach AQI, sources and protection to Class 9+ students.
